Quick sum for founders.

Hours a week you spend on admin: 6
Weeks in a month: about 4.3
What an hour of your time is worth: say $60

6 x 4.3 x $60 = $1,548 a month of your time on inbox, invoices and scheduling.

For comparison, 80 hours a month of a dedicated assistant is $500.

This is not a promise of savings. It is a way to put a price on the hours you give away.

What number do you get?

#SmallBusiness #Delegation
